2607.28627.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
2607.28627.paper_summary: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benchmarks: on Visual Haystacks it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative), and on LVBench it transfers zero-shot to long video for an 8.0-point gain with Qwen3VL-8B. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken
2607.28627.paper_summary_zh: 長視覺上下文對於視覺-語言模型來說是一個挑戰：隨著干擾項數量的增加，性能會下降，而在 GPU 記憶體限制下，同時處理所有標記在計算上是不可行的。我們提出了 ReToken，一個單一的可學習嵌入，作為明確的檢索目標進行訓練，從預填充的視覺 KV 緩存中選擇一組稀疏的查詢相關視覺標記。僅在一個小型圖像-QA 數據集上進行訓練，ReToken 在圖像和視頻基準上均取得了一致的增益：在 Visual Haystacks 上，它使 Qwen3VL-8B 提升了 13.4 分，InternVL3.5 提升了 12.4 分（相對增益超過 20%），而在 LVBench 上，它在長視頻中零樣本轉移，為 Qwen3VL-8B 帶來了 8.0 分的增益。得益於其輕量設計，訓練和長視頻推理均可在單個 H100 上進行。代碼可在以下位置獲得：https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken
